mapper.select: SELECT id, accident_no, company_id, business_number, vessel_id, accident_date, accident_location, victim_name, victim_age, victim_gender, victim_role, accident_type, severity, description, treatment_days, absence_days, reported_by, reported_at, report_file_url, created_at, updated_at, deleted FROM tb_industrial_accident WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT ia.id, ia.accident_no, ia.company_id, c.name AS company_name, ia.business_number, ia.vessel_id, v.name AS vessel_name, ia.accident_date, ia.accident_location, ia.victim_name, ia.victim_age, ia.victim_gender, ia.victim_role, ia.accident_type, ia.severity, ia.description, ia.treatment_days, ia.absence_days, ia.reported_by, ru.name AS reporter_name, ia.reported_at, ia.report_file_url, ia.created_at, ia.updated_at FROM tb_industrial_accident ia LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = ia.company_id AND c.deleted = 0 LEFT JOIN tb_vessel v ON v.id = ia.vessel_id LEFT JOIN tb_user ru ON ru.id = ia.reported_by AND ru.deleted = 0 WHERE ia.id = #{id} AND ia.deleted = 0

SELECT ia.id, ia.accident_no, ia.company_id, c.name AS company_name, ia.business_number, ia.accident_date, ia.accident_location, ia.victim_name, ia.accident_type, ia.severity, ia.created_at FROM tb_industrial_accident ia LEFT JOIN tb_company c ON c.id = ia.company_id AND c.deleted = 0
ORDER BY ia.accident_date DESC, ia.created_at DESC OFFSET #{offset} ROWS FETCH NEXT #{limit} ROWS ONLY
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tb_industrial_accident ( accident_no, company_id, business_number, vessel_id, accident_date, accident_location, victim_name, victim_age, victim_gender, victim_role, accident_type, severity, description, treatment_days, absence_days, reported_by, reported_at, report_file_url, created_at, deleted ) VALUES ( #{accidentNo}, #{companyId}, #{businessNumber}, #{vesselId}, #{accidentDate}, #{accidentLocation}, #{victimName}, #{victimAge}, #{victimGender}, #{victimRole}, #{accidentType}, #{severity}, #{description}, #{treatmentDays}, #{absenceDays}, #{reportedBy}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), #{reportFileUrl}, SYSUTCDATETIME(), 0 )
mapper.update: UPDATE tb_industrial_accident SET business_number = #{businessNumber}, vessel_id = #{vesselId}, accident_date = #{accidentDate}, accident_location = #{accidentLocation}, victim_name = #{victimName}, victim_age = #{victimAge}, victim_gender = #{victimGender}, victim_role = #{victimRole}, accident_type = #{accidentType}, severity = #{severity}, description = #{description}, treatment_days = #{treatmentDays}, absence_days = #{absenceDays}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_industrial_accident SET report_file_url = #{reportFileUrl}, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
UPDATE tb_industrial_accident SET deleted = 1, updated_at = SYSUTCDATETIME() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT ISNULL(MAX(CAST(RIGHT(accident_no, 4) AS INT)), 0) FROM tb_industrial_accident WHERE accident_no LIKE 'IA-' + #{dateStr} + '-%'
